design_concept: Industrial Field Service - Built for high-glare environments, sunlight legibility, and rugged usage on construction sites. Prioritizes maximum luminance contrast, large touch targets, and distinct color-coded chips over soft aesthetics.

typography.guidelines: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings, tight tracking (tracking-tight) and uppercase for overlines. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text to ensure optimal legibility and a technical blueprint feel. (Import via Google Fonts).

visual_enhancers.borders: Heavy 2px black borders (border-2 border-zinc-900) on cards, inputs, and buttons are MANDATORY for sunlight legibility.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard offset shadows for interactivity (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(9,9,11,1)]). NO soft blur shadows. Solid technical look.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm maximum to maintain a rugged, industrial aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height (h-12) for ALL clickable elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, dropdowns) to support field usage with dirty hands/gloves.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Generous padding p-4 to p-6. Elements must not feel cramped. Large text, clear hierarchy.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use technical grid borders (border-collapse style) for data-heavy sections like daily logs and task lists.
spacing_and_layout.mobile_navigation: Bottom navigation bar is strictly required for mobile screens for thumb accessibility.

component_instructions.buttons: Thick 2px borders, solid backgrounds (Black or Safety Yellow), hard offset shadows. Text must be bold, uppercase. Active state should compress the shadow (translate-y-1 translate-x-1 shadow-none).
component_instructions.cards: White background, 2px solid black border. Content must have high contrast. Use subgrid layouts for metrics.
component_instructions.inputs: Large hit area (h-12). 2px solid border. Focus state must use a thick high-contrast outline (e.g., ring-offset-2 ring-2 ring-zinc-900).
component_instructions.data_display: Dates MUST be formatted strictly as DD/MM/YYYY IST. Use large, legible numbers for labor count and metrics.
component_instructions.photo_grid: For Daily Logs, display photos in a tight 2-column or 3-column grid with 2px borders around each image. Max 10 photos.
component_instructions.avatars: Square avatars with sharp borders instead of circles to match the industrial theme.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 7:1 contrast ratio for critical text (Sunlight visibility protocol).
accessibility.touch: Fat-finger touch targets required (min h-12 or 48x48px).
accessibility.motion: Minimal motion. Use instant state changes or very fast transitions (duration-75) to feel responsive and reliable on low-end devices.

icons.style: Always use weight='bold' or weight='fill' for distinct visibility outdoors.

placeholders.description: Two workers discussing plans on a sandy construction site. Use for login hero or project covers.
Textured grey concrete wall. Use for subtle background textures or empty states.

images.usage: Use for login screen backgrounds, project covers, or avatar fallbacks. Never use generic placeholder URLs.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). All components must be .jsx or .js
DO NOT USE complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or any surface over content.
Avoid centered layouts for forms or lists; always left-align for quick reading.
Implement high-contrast state changes for hover/active/focus (e.g., invert colors on click).
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
Do not use generic 'AI slop' gradients or soft shadows. Stick to the hard, brutalist, industrial look with flat colors and thick borders.
All modals and dialogs must have heavy borders and solid backdrop (bg-zinc-900/80) rather than a light blur, to block out background noise completely.
Use solid Phosphor icons (weight='bold' or 'fill'). Use 'sonner' for toast notifications.
